title: The Happy Surfer 30A | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: The Happy Surfer 30A — a house in Seacrest Beach, Florida. 12 guests · 4 bedrooms · 4 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'The Happy Surfer 30A', your perfect coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Designed for relaxation, connection, and unforgettable beach memories, this beautifully appointed four-bedroom, four-bathroom home offers the ideal blend of comfort, style, and convenience along Scenic Highway 30A.Perfect for families and group getaways, The Happy Surfer 30A comfortably accommodates guests with thoughtfully designed living space and a layout that makes spending time together effortless. The open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area provides a welcoming space to gather for meals, plan beach adventures, or unwind after a day in the sun.The home features four comfortable bedrooms and four full bathrooms, including two bunk rooms that are perfect for kids, teens, or additional guests. The flexible sleeping arrangements make The Happy Surfer 30A an excellent choice for multiple families, group vacations, and beach getaways with friends.One of the highlights of staying in Seacrest Beach is access to the community's spectacular 12,000-square-foot resort-style pool, one of the largest on 30A. Surrounded by palm trees and plenty of lounge space, it's the perfect place to spend a relaxing afternoon when you're not at the beach. Guests can also enjoy the convenience of the on-site café, where you can grab lunch, snacks, and refreshing drinks without ever leaving the pool area.Nestled between the iconic communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this prime Seacrest Beach location places you just moments from some of 30A's best dining, shopping, entertainment, and beach access. Spend your days exploring charming beach towns by bike, lounging by the pool, or soaking up the sunshine on the beautiful white-sand beaches that make 30A so special.Guests can enjoy complimentary bikes, convenient parking, and easy access to nearby beach tram stops, making it simple to experience everything Seacrest Beach and 30A have to offer.Whether you're heading to the beach, biking to nearby communities, spending the day poolside, or enjoying dinner along 30A, The Happy Surfer 30A offers the perfect setting for a memorable Emerald Coast getaway.HOME HIGHLIGHTSPrivate Deeded Beach Access**Due to the Hurricane the private beach access will remain closed until the necessary repairs can be evaluated and completed and the structure is deemed safe for use.Third-Floor Porch with Spectacular Sunset ViewsCentrally Located between Rosemary and Alys Beach6 Adult BikesOutdoor Sitting AreasGas GrillSmart TVs in each BedroomBeach TramBeach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Boogie Boards, Toys & Coolers2 Dedicated Parking Spots with Additional Parking Available Throughout the CommunityFull Sized Washer & DryerACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 124 Bedrooms / 4 BathsFIRST FLOORLaundryKitchenDiningLivingBedroom 1: (2) Twin/Twin Bunk BedsFull Bathroom with Walk-In ShowerSECOND FLOORBedroom 2: King with EnsuiteBedroom 3: King + Twin/Twin Bunk with EnsuiteTHIRD FLOORKitchenetteBedroom 4: KingFull Bathroom With Walk-In Shower & TubWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGTwo parking spaces available (2 driveway). Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security.Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSSeacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you're ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida.Please Note:*Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals.AMENITY ACCESSIn order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.BEACH ACCESSSeacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Capacity for 2 vehicles in the driveway.*Home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a selfie.Other things to note
